edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender of the token transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender deducting allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the owner of the approval in approve.
transfer invokes the private _transfer logic.
transferFrom invokes the private _transfer logic.
_transfer delegates state accounting to _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard.
_transfer performs an external swap call before updating balances, enabling reentrancy.
_transfer sends ETH to fee wallets before final accounting, enabling reentrancy.
swapTokensForEth calls the untrusted Uniswap router, which can re-enter the token.
sendETHToFee performs ETH transfers that can re-enter if the recipient is a contract.
Router swap callback path can re-enter _transfer while the swap flag/state is mid-update.
Fee wallet ETH transfer fallback can re-enter _transfer before accounting completes.
block.timestamp gates cooldown checks and writes cooldown[to], a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
cooldown mapping is read and written inside _transfer.
_maxTxAmount is enforced on buy transfers in _transfer.
bots blacklist is consulted before allowing a transfer.
uniswapV2Pair identity determines buy detection and swap triggering.
inSwap flag guards against nested swap execution.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap-and-send path.
cooldownEnabled gates the anti-bot cooldown logic.
_transfer ultimately mutates _rOwned through _transferStandard.
transferFrom path approves allowances affected by _transfer.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH on the router.
openTrading calls factory.createPair to create the trading pair.
openTrading is protected by the onlyOwner modifier based on _owner.
setBots is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
delBot is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
setCooldownEnabled is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
setFeeAmountOne authorizes the caller against _feeAddrWallet2 using msg.sender.
setFeeAmountTwo authorizes the caller against _feeAddrWallet2 using msg.sender.
manualswap restricts execution to _feeAddrWallet1 via msg.sender.
manualsend restricts execution to _feeAddrWallet1 via msg.sender.
setFeeAmountOne writes the _feeAddr1 tax fee.
setFeeAmountTwo writes the _feeAddr2 team fee.
manualswap triggers the external swap path outside the normal transfer flow.
manualsend triggers ETH transfers to fee wallets.
openTrading stores the Uniswap router address.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
swapTokensForEth reads the router to build the swap path.
swapTokensForEth approves the router allowance in _allowances.
_transferStandard debits sender and credits recipient reflection balances.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal after each standard transfer.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal with collected fees.
sendETHToFee transfers half the balance to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee transfers half the balance to _feeAddrWallet2.
setBots marks supplied addresses as bots.
delBot clears the bot flag for an address.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldownEnabled flag.
recipient parameter flows into the private _transfer destination.
amount parameter flows into _transfer and the max tx check.
token amount derived from the transfer is forwarded to the router swap.
sender parameter flows into _transfer during transferFrom.
contractTokenBalance is passed as tokenAmount into swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is forwarded as the amount to sendETHToFee.
currentRate is used to compute reflection amounts in _transferStandard.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only a transient transfer destination consumed by _transfer's balance update.
amount is fully consumed by _transfer and the max transaction check, no independent semantics.
sender is the debit source merged into the private _transfer accounting.
contractTokenBalance is solely the argument passed to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is solely the argument passed to sendETHToFee.
currentRate is only an intermediate rate used inside the standard transfer accounting.
